title: Azza Zin's Creepers
description: Azza Zin's Creepers — The Townstons wiki
html:
Azza Zin's Creepers
Piece:  Boots
Class:  Mage
Defense Rating:  varies with item level

Azza Zin's Creepers are mage boots.

It is unknown how many different varieties of this particular mythic item exist. Some of the Mythic items in this series may have the same name but different attributes.

This item is soulbound.

Attributes:

The name and the look are fixed. The joke ending is one of the six mage armor suffixes. That ending is what sets Endurance / Intellect.

The rest of the stats roll and do not show up in the name.

  • Element: fire, ice, shadow, or a combo of those. Random.
  • Resists: a random pair or triple from divine, fire, ice, poison, and shadow.
  • Health / mana: health, mana, or both. Random.
  • Crit: crit chance or crit damage. Random.

This piece does not roll casting speed. Casting speed shows up on Threadz and Ma'nes instead.

It is unknown how many different varieties exist. The same ending can still drop with different rolls underneath.
